Settings

App-wide preferences
Appearance

Changes how the site looks on this device only. Downloaded PDFs and printed pamphlets always stay light — this never affects what a prospect or resident sees.

Refresh Site to Update

If a feature seems missing or a fix doesn't seem to have taken effect, your browser may be showing a cached copy of the page. This forces a fresh copy from the server — it does not affect your saved data (Residents, Waitlist, pricing, etc.), which lives in local storage and/or your shared backend, separate from the page itself.

App Mode

Live uses whatever you've actually uploaded on the Tour, Expiring, and Renewals tabs. Test swaps in sample data on every tab — real unit numbers with made-up prices and dates — so you can try out new features without touching your real data. Your live data stays exactly as you left it in local storage and comes right back when you switch back to Live.

Currently in Live mode.
Shared Backend (Google Sheet)

Without this, every upload and every renewal checkbox/note lives only in your own browser — other agents can't see it. Paste in your deployed Apps Script Web App URL below (same URL for everyone on the team) to share the pricing sheet, expiring report, renewal report, and renewal tracker notes across all agents automatically.

Not configured — data stays local to this browser only.
Need this set up? Ask Claude for the Apps Script code and step-by-step deployment instructions — it's a one-time, ~5 minute setup on a Google Sheet you control.
